meta.title: PTC Creator Mode
meta.description: The union the shipped presets never shipped: PTC mode (run_code as the orchestration surface) plus the Creation-mode Cordis toolset and authoring skills, declared live on the preset roster. The workflow tool is never offered; the run_code backend switch chooses the official Node/TypeScript backend or the experimental CPython one. Requires dsh >=0.2.2-rc.1.
